CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  NOTICE OF REGULAR MEETING
  OF THE
  ALHAMBRA TRANSPORTATION COMMISSION
  WEDNESDAY, MAY 11, 2022
  7:00 p.m.

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that a Regular Meeting of the
Alhambra Transportation Commission will be held on Wednesday, MAY
11, 2022 at 7:00 p.m. at Alhambra City Hall Conference Room A, 111 South
First Street, Alhambra, California, pursuant to the order of the Alhambra
Transportation Commission Secretary.

An agenda of such regular meeting is attached hereto, incorporated herein by
reference and made a part hereof as though fully set forth herein.

  Martin W. Ray
  Alhambra Transportation Commission Secretary

Notice No: N2M22-58
Posted:  May 5, 2022
   CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  AGENDA
  Regular Meeting
  ALHAMBRA TRANSPORTATION COMMISSION
  City Hall, 111 South First Street
  May 11, 2022
  7:00 p.m.

  ROLL CALL:
  Steven Placido, Henry Aviles, Cliff Bender, Antonio Chavira, Gwen Chen,
  Lilian De Loza Gutierrez, Albert Lu, Monica Calderon

  FLAG SALUTE:  Commission President Placido

  PRESENTATIONS

  1. ELECTION OF OFFICERS

  Each year the committee is appointed by the City Council. At this time, it is appropriate to conduct
  an election to determine which members will chair the meeting as president and in the event the
  chair cannot attend the meeting, determine which member will step in as Vice President to
  conduct the meeting.

  Recommended Action: That the Committee elect a new president and vice president to chair the
  meeting.

  2.  TRAFFIC REVIEW OF REQUEST FOR RED CURB ON THE SOUTH SIDE OF DRIVEWAY
  AT 928 S 2ND STREET TO INCREASE LINE OF SIGHT AT THE DRIVEWAY

  Staff will review the report that was prepared in response to a concern of resident having difficulty
  when larger vehicles or vehicles park too close to their driveway limiting their ability to safely enter
  and exit the driveway especially when backing out.

  After a thorough review of existing field and traffic conditions and per the guidelines in the
  California Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices (CAMUTCD), California Vehicle Code
  (CVC), and based on engineering judgement, a list of options is presented to Traffic Commission
  for review and direction.

  Recommended Action

  It is recommended that the Transportation Commission review the report with the City Traffic
  Engineer, listen to public comment and provide direction.

  3. PUBLIC COMMENTS

  Comments must pertain to the business of the Transportation Commission. Kindly limit all oral
  communications to five (5) minutes.

 4. COMMENTS AND CONCERNS FROM COMMISSION MEMBERS AND/OR STAFF.

Comments, concerns or discussion on any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items discussed
must pertain to the business of the Alhambra Transportation Commission.

5. ADJOURNMENT

  Adjournment to a regular meeting on Wednesday, July 13, 2022 at 7:00 p.m.

Copies of staff reports or other written documentation, if any, relating to each item of business
described above are on file in the Alhambra City Hall, Public Works Department, 111 S. First
Street, Alhambra California 91801 and are available for public inspection upon request during
regular business hours of 7:00am to 5:30pm, Monday through Thursday.

Should any person have a question concerning any of the above agenda items prior to the
meeting described herein, he or she may contact Martin Ray, Director of Public Works & Utilities,
either in person at the Public Works Department at Alhambra City Hall, 111 South First Street, or
by calling via telephone at (626) 570-5067 during regular business hours.
